verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents a monitoring feature that gives insights into potential registration obligations (economic nexus) and identifies where you might need to register based on past transactions. The evidence describes after-the-fact analysis of past transactions, not documented threshold-by-threshold tracking or forward-looking alerts. missing for 10: documented tracking of sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold, proactive alerting before a threshold is crossed, independent or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring feature.

support.subject: As a founder, the product watches my economic nexus exposure — tracking sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold and alerting me before I cross one, not after

citations.quote: Stripe Tax provides insights about your potential tax registration obligations (called economic nexus in the US).
Identify where you might need to register to collect tax based on past transactions.
